metadata.description: Authored bus services for the route select screen. Route numbers, stop names, stop placements and waiting passengers are fictional prototype data, not published bus routes or timetables.
metadata.geometry: Legs reuse existing alignments: 'nathan' is the Nathan Road service corridor in nathan-road.json (its stops stay there); 'drive' indexes the government-derived drives in cross-harbour.json, optionally cut at 'to' metres.
metadata.units: start, stop distance and lane are metres along / across the joined route; negative lane is left of the centreline in the direction of travel.
